# Dispatch 809 sources (byte copies)

The file the homepage status strings (COO dispatch 809 §7, 2026-11-06: the three status
words, the register-derived vertical badges, the metric label and the primitive-status
sentence) were generated from, taken 2026-11-05 (desk time; 2026-11-06 UTC).
`scripts/status_copy_text.py` was generated from it by programmatic extraction
(`scripts/gen_status_copy_text.py`; no string retyped), and `scripts/test_status_strings.py`
re-derives every constant from this file, asserts byte equality, and pins its SHA-256.

The copy is LF-only, so its house pin (sha256 after CRLF→LF, first 16) is
`c7271feef01379d7`, the pin dispatch 809 was received under.

`.gitattributes` marks `tests/fixtures/**` `-text`, so a Windows checkout keeps these bytes.

Do not edit this file. A corrected source is a new copy with a new hash, and the generated
module is regenerated from it.
